items.title: Frank Alkyer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 10, 2020
items.q: Oh yeah. That would be a great one too.

ctx.x: Yeah. But if I could sit down a day with Thelonious, if I could spend a day with Thelonious Monk I would have loved to spend a day with Thelonious Monk. If I could spend a day with Ellington, oh my gosh would that be a great day in life. You know Charles Mingus. If I could sit down with Charles. When I read Beneath the Underdog when it first came out, I just go, I wish I could have — because I just thought it was a brilliant book and the way that he did it in the third person. It was, I wish I could have spent…
Cannonball Adderley was my guy. He still is my guy as far a just the whole package.
Oh yeah. That would be a great one too.
